payload.entry: LAND FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: Used /sase_new_task; searched all-status ci/flake reports, swept both last-week catalogs, inspected active epics and plausible owners. Phase sase-1pu.5.1.5.1 note 1: DECLINED new task as fixed by sase-core dc119c0b from closed sase-1qk.1 (four staged_handoff files; recorded fmt-check passed). Added resolution evidence to existing owner sase-1pj.6.1. Phase sase-1pu.5.1.5.2 note 1: CORROBORATED existing sase-19m (+1) with audited ToolRun af92a91bfbe6635cd5c072966a9dc112, exit 1, FLAKY timeout-vs-rate_limited, verdict no_new_failures, possible_owners empty after timeout. No new tasks. Include both outcomes in eventual close note. The product defects found by this landing audit remain this epic work and will be planned, not filed as unrelated tasks.

LAND AUDIT / NOT READY (HEAD=origin/master a0b00da79b): reviewed both child scopes and every note, core dc5383f6 source/bindings and Python a0b00da79b, containing pin, and inherited optional_scope=keep_five_seeds. Existing repair/preservation/scheduler tests pass 47/47 in 41.05s; phase ToolRun af92a91bfbe6635cd5c072966a9dc112 is exit 1 / no_new_failures (only FLAKY AGY probe), not a green exit. Integration reviewed: intervening 288d2afeeb readoption changes held notification text, not outcomes/publication; core dc119c0b is formatting-only. No epic-symbol entries for this epic or sase-1pu.5.1. Confirmed remaining acceptance failures with real temp sidecar/index probe: missing archive index invokes rebuild; stale current artifact_agent_id still completes the old indexed run; meta.name conflict is overwritten by done.name; artifact symlink escape accepted; real dismissed bundle with agent_name differing from cl_name is missed; stale summary/current bundle mismatch still dismisses the wrong run; state_limit=1 page planning reads an unselected prompt and eight hood snapshots; last marker read crossing deadline still returns changed=1, next cursor, error=None, budget_exhausted=False. Reproducer file:explicit:ed35fecafbc1e54897ae808e. These are epic-caused unfinished contracts. Preparing a medium tale using existing Rust APIs to fix adapters, bounded page planning and deadline reporting, with production regression tests and mandatory same-turn closeout of this epic, ready parent plan sase-1pu.5.1, and only phase sase-1pu.5. No close attempted and plan status remains unfinished.

LAND AUDIT EVIDENCE: Saved executable temporary-fixture probe file:explicit:ed35fecafbc1e54897ae808e and result log file:explicit:80004e2a57ce240ac8f0ef75. Refetched both origin/master branches before proposal: sase remains a0b00da79b and core dc119c0b, so no additional post-audit drift. Remaining-work tale sase_plan_exact_state_closeout.md passed validate --explain after adding required title/goal, then validate without --explain with zero warnings. It uses existing core APIs and includes all repairs, production read instrumentation, just check verification, this epic closeout and conditional parent-plan/phase closeout in the coding turn. This epic and its linked plan deliberately remain open until those contracts pass.

Closed remaining exact-run adapter/deadline contracts on dirty tree at a0b00da79b. Focused pytest tests/agents_sync/test_publication_state_repair + test_publication_targeted.py: 50 passed in 38.47s. just fix formatted the dirty files. sase tool run check e1f6b07ae4b3cd6b69c3d9f10f78f10f: lint green, 59580 passed, 17 skipped; 1 NEW tests/test_sudo_ledger_settlement.py::test_sudo_answer_defers_after_long_lock_timeout_and_reclaim_settles_later (assert settled==deferred, touched=false, signature c0d9ad62…). Serial rerun of that node passed in 3.63s. Corroborated existing flake sase-1oy (+1). No product failure in publication-state files.

Fixes: filesystem observations always emit current metadata identity beside a present terminal so changed durable IDs/names reach Rust identity_conflict; dismissed lookup uses query_summaries (no rebuild) matching agent_name/source_run_id/raw_suffix; canonical-path symlink-escape reject; bounded artifact query (limit 32, no include_full_history); malformed/unreadable metadata always emitted; hood snapshots carried from discovery; previous_snapshot single bounded read; state-only pages skip index regeneration (include_index_pages=False); any planned.error including budget freeze cursor without payload/push-ahead.

Inherited optional_scope=keep_five_seeds. Core pin remains dc5383f6 (no new core API). epic-symbols sase-1pu.5.1.5: none. Newer origin/master 17d8fe5937/a19243cdf6/71827cfecc are gate-turn/staged-handoff; no publication overlap.
